source.design_provenance: ui-acid-v1 Acid Hardware direction (docs/ui/ui-direction.md) and the user-approved generated draft output/imagegen/prompts/logo-c3-cjk-pure-type.txt (untracked)
source.rebuild: Programmatic re-typeset after the generated raster proved unusable at pixel level (dither noise, eroded strokes, merged junctions invisible in downscaled previews). Characters: Microsoft YaHei Bold, programmatically thickened; caption: Consolas Bold, letter-spaced.

data.description: Primary Chinese wordmark for 声间 (Shengjian): the two characters in ultra-heavy geometric CJK lettering, structurally exact, with caption "SHENGJIAN" in letter-spaced monospace, acid chartreuse on near-black. Exact colors: #e1f607 / #7d8a7d / #050505.
data.variant_note: Third round of logo exploration: c2 (waveform underline) rejected for edge artifacts, c3 (pure type) adopted then rebuilt programmatically for cleanliness. Rejection chain recorded in docs/ui/ui-direction.md session notes.

reuse: Rendered entirely from system fonts on a #050505 canvas, trimmed to content, saved as lossless WebP (1305x748, aspect 1.74:1). Clean at any zoom. Used as the README.zh-CN.md header logo (display width 360).
